US markets bounced back Monday as investors regained appetite for risk ahead of earnings, midterm elections, and a crucial jobs report. The rebound follows an AI-driven sell-off that wiped out roughly $5 trillion in October.
Apollo Global chief economist Torsten Slok: "the Fed would need to raise the Fed funds rate by about 275 basis points...to bring CPI back to its 2% target"
Oracle announced a $20 billion capital raise, with stock dropping 5% on leverage concerns.
